python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
p='file:/app/main.db?mode=ro'
con=sqlite3.connect(p, uri=True)
print('journal_mode:', con.execute('pragma journal_mode').fetchone()[0])
print('tables:', con.execute("select name, sql from sqlite_master where type='table' order by name").fetchall())
for t, in con.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table' and name not like 'sqlite_%' order by name"):
    print('rows from', t, ':', con.execute('select * from "'+t.replace('"','""')+'" order by 1').fetchall())
con.close()
PY
